body.statement: Uniformly over \(c\in\mathcal C\), \(\sup_{c\in\mathcal C}\|\sqrt n\{\widehat\tau(c)-\tau(c)\}-n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n(\psi^\theta_c(O_i),\psi^W_c(O_i),\psi^K_c(O_i))\|=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\). Jointly, the two implemented-rule evaluation errors satisfy \(\sup_{c\in\mathcal C}|\sqrt n\{\widehat W(\widehat\theta_c)-W(\widehat\theta_c)\}-n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\phi^W_c(O_i)|=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\) and the analogous statement with \(K\) and \(\phi^K_c\). Therefore the full stack converges in \(C(\mathcal C)^{d+4}\) to \(G\) with kernel \(\Gamma\), and at every finite deterministic collection of penalty coordinates the optimizer coordinates jointly attain the semiparametric covariance bound generated by \(\psi_c^\theta\). On the common regular finite-action benchmark-centered softmax submodel, set FangRidderXie2026's optimization penalty to \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c\), so its reported preference is \(c_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c/s_W^{\mathrm{FRX}}\). This is the uniform-in-penalty extension of the fixed-penalty efficient influence bound in its Theorem 1 and the efficient doubly robust optimizer limit in its Theorem 5.
body.justification: On the common softmax submodel, a decision maker sees and selects from the whole preference curve; the contribution is the joint uniform process under explicitly maintained path-uniform interiority, three-derivative smoothness, and curvature, built on quantitative foldwise same-sample-path replacement.
body.gap: FangRidderXie2026 Theorem 1 gives the efficient influence function and bound, while Theorem 5 gives the efficient doubly robust optimizer and its limit at fixed optimization penalty \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}>0\). Restricting its admissible-rule framework to \(\{\pi_\theta:\theta\in\Theta\}\) and mapping \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c\), equivalently \(c_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c/s_W^{\mathrm{FRX}}\), the gap is a joint uniform oracle-and-implemented frontier process under separately stated stronger path-uniform regularity; generic indexed Z-estimation supplies tools but not this verified composition.
body.consumer: The commitment-savings frontier in FangRidderXie2026 can be reported on the common regular softmax submodel with correlated uncertainty for every displayed preference rather than unrelated pointwise standard errors.
